description: This Java class 'CloseRecurringDepositAccountCommandHandler' handles the command for closing a recurring deposit account within the Fineract project. It implements the 'NewCommandSourceHandler' interface, processes the closure command, and interacts with the 'DepositAccountWritePlatformService' to perform the operation.

classes.name: CloseRecurringDepositAccountCommandHandler
classes.description: This class handles the command to close a recurring deposit account, invoking the service method to perform the account closure.

methods.name: CloseRecurringDepositAccountCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the DepositAccountWritePlatformService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Handles the incoming command to close the RD account by delegating to the service layer.
